title: Decorate Challenge
meta: Premade cupcakes or craft, no oven

blocks.title: Mission
blocks.text: Work as a team to decorate cupcakes using a shared vision and collaborative planning.

blocks.title: Food route: check first
blocks.text: Follow your school’s food policy. Check every student’s allergies and dietary needs against all ingredient labels. If food won’t work for everyone, use the craft route.

items: Print one Decorate Challenge Card per team; gather your route’s materials (page 2)
One station per team of 3–4: cupcakes or craft bases, decorations, scrap paper
Food route: plan hand-washing and keep an adult at the stations throughout

items.title: Launch
items.text: Hand out the cards and read the mission. Decorations stay closed until the plan is agreed.

items.title: Everyone adds an idea
items.text: Each student names or sketches one decorating idea on scrap paper.

items.title: Agree one plan and roles
items.text: Agree one design that keeps part of each idea; choose roles (page 2). Check plans first.
prompts: Who hasn’t added an idea yet?

items.title: Decorate together
items.text: Food route: wash hands first. Teams follow their plan and agree before changing it.
prompts: Does this still match your plan?

items.title: Clean up
items.text: Food: follow school policy on eating or taking cupcakes home; wipe stations, wash hands. Craft: let glue dry; return supplies.

items.title: Share one decision
items.text: Each team explains one decision it made together and what it would try next.
Premade cupcakes; frosting and decorations (your choice). Add spreading tools, plates, napkins and wipes for each station.

Paper cupcake liners; card or paper rolled or cut into a cupcake base; tissue paper or cotton balls for frosting; markers, stickers or paper scraps for decorations; glue sticks, tape and safety scissors.

blocks.text: Craft route, step by step: glue the base into the liner, add the “frosting” on top, then decorate it to the team’s plan. No oven or food is needed for either route.

items.text: Keeps the team to its plan and checks that every idea is heard.
Collects decorations from the station and shares them fairly.
Watches the time so the team finishes before clean-up.
Leads clean-up at the station. In teams of 3, the Timekeeper also cleans up.

blocks.text: Everyone decorates; a role adds one job.

items: The team creates a shared plan before decorating.
All team members contribute ideas, and the finished cupcakes show part of each one.
Students demonstrate respectful collaboration and compromise.
The team can explain one decision it made together.

items.text: Each person names one part of their idea that must stay.
Keep the colours from one idea and the decorations from another.
Ask what the team could change without starting over, then let them agree.

source_note: PROTOTYPE 2026-11-03.
